### Clonal expansion of selected TCRs
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=17}

meta <- read.xlsx('/home/zeemeeuw/data/mmJoint/cleanTCR/Lm-TCR4.57-clonotypes-paired in rna.xlsx') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(tissue = str_extract(Tissue_time, "(.*)-", group = 1)) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode) %>% 
  distinct(CDRa_CDRb, timepoint, tissue, barcode, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!str_detect(CDRa_CDRb, "_")) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(tissue == "Spleen") %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint != "WT") %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint %in% c("d3", "d8", "R5")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = case_match(timepoint, c("d3") ~ "Priming", c("R5", "Y5") ~ "Recall", .default = "Primary")) %>% 
  group_by(CDRa_CDRb, group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(n = n()) %>% 
  group_by(group) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(total_n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

tcr <- read_tsv('TCR_cloned_CDR.tsv')

plist <- list()
for(phase in c("Priming", "Primary", "Recall")){
  meta_phase <- meta %>% dplyr::filter(group == phase) %>% 
    dplyr::select(CDRa_CDRb, group)
  tcr_phase <- tcr %>% dplyr::filter(group == phase)
  
  data <- meta_phase %>% 
    left_join(tcr_phase, by = join_by(CDRa_CDRb, group)) %>% 
    group_by(CDRa_CDRb) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(n = n()) %>% 
    arrange(desc(n), desc(id)) %>% 
    distinct() %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(x = row_number()) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(selected = if_else(is.na(id), "N", "Y")) %>% 
    arrange(selected)
  
 
  p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = n, fill = selected, color = selected, shape = selected, size = n)) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    geom_point() +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 21)) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 5)) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Y" = "#FBE6BF", "N" = "grey70")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Y" = "black", "N" = "grey70"))  +
    ggtitle(phase)
  
  plist <- c(plist, list(p1))
}
wrap_plots(plist, nrow = 1)
  
```

### Tet MFI and %tet+ of selected TCRs
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=17}

data <- readxl::read_excel("20251111-TCR213-275-Tet binding MFI-Prop-mean_3.xlsx") %>% 
  rename_with(~c("phase", "TCR_rep", "mean_MFI", "mean_prop")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(TCR = str_extract(TCR_rep, "(.*)-(.*)", group = 1),
                rep = str_extract(TCR_rep, "(.*)-(.*)", group = 2)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(phase), ~factor(.x, levels = c("Ctrl", "Priming", "Primary", "Recall"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(log_MFI = log10(mean_MFI)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(x = case_match(phase, "Ctrl" ~ 1, "Priming" ~ 2, "Primary" ~ 3, "Recall" ~ 4)) %>% 
  arrange(phase, TCR, rep) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(x = consecutive_id(TCR)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(TCR), ~factor(.x, levels = level_TCR))


data_summary <- data %>% group_by(TCR, x) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(group_MFI = mean(mean_MFI), 
                   group_prop = mean(mean_prop),
                   sem_MFI = plotrix::std.error(mean_MFI),
                   sem_prop = plotrix::std.error(mean_prop))

barwidth <- 0.7
# MFI
ggplot() +
  geom_errorbar(data = data_summary, aes(x = x, ymax = group_MFI + sem_MFI, ymin = group_MFI - sem_MFI), width = barwidth/2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(data = data_summary, aes(x = x, y = group_MFI, fill = TCR), stat = 'identity', width = barwidth, alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(data = data, aes(x = x, y = mean_MFI, fill = TCR), shape = 21, size = 1, width = barwidth/4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_TCR) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("Tet MFI") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", hjust = 1, angle = 45),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:nrow(data_summary), labels = levels(data$TCR), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  scale_y_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = data_summary %>% dplyr::filter(TCR == "jurkat") %>% pull(group_MFI), color = "black", linetype = 2) +
  scale_y_break(c(20,80), space = 0.1, scales = 8)



ggplot() +
  geom_errorbar(data = data_summary, aes(x = x, ymax = group_prop + sem_prop, ymin = group_prop - sem_prop), width = barwidth/2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(data = data_summary, aes(x = x, y = group_prop, fill = TCR), stat = 'identity', width = barwidth, alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(data = data, aes(x = x, y = mean_prop, fill = TCR), shape = 21, size = 1, width = barwidth/4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_TCR) +
  xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("% Tet") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", hjust = 1, angle = 45),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:nrow(data_summary), labels = levels(data$TCR), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) 
  
```

### T test for Tet MFI and %tet+ of selected TCRs in different phase
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

data <- readxl::read_excel("/home/zeemeeuw/data/mmJoint/TCR/ymdata/20251111-TCR213-275-Tet binding MFI-Prop-mean.xlsx") %>% 
  rename_with(~c("phase", "TCR_rep", "mean_MFI", "mean_prop")) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(phase), ~factor(.x, levels = c("Ctrl", "Priming", "Primary", "Recall"))) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(log_MFI = log10(mean_MFI)) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(x = case_match(phase, "Ctrl" ~ 1, "Priming" ~ 2, "Primary" ~ 3, "Recall" ~ 4))

comb <- t(combn(levels(data$phase), 2)) %>% as_tibble()
df_sig <- lapply(1:nrow(comb), function(i) {
  guse <- comb[i,]
  t <- wilcox.test(x = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V1) %>% pull(log_MFI),
              y = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V2) %>% pull(log_MFI), paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE)
  c <- tibble(p = t$p.value, 
              xmin = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V1) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
              xmax = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V2) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
              x_min_group = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V1) %>% pull(phase) %>% unique(),
              x_max_group = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V2) %>% pull(phase) %>% unique(),
              y = max(data$log_MFI)/100*(70 + i*3))
}) %>% Reduce("rbind", .)


calc_boxplot_stats <- function(x) {
  qs <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- qs[3] - qs[1]
  lower_whisker <- max(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), qs[1] - 1.5 * iqr)
  upper_whisker <- min(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), qs[3] + 1.5 * iqr)
  
  stats <- log10(c(lower_whisker, qs[1], qs[2], qs[3], upper_whisker))
  names(stats) <- c("ymin", "lower", "middle", "upper", "ymax")
  return(stats)
}

ggplot(data, aes(x = phase, y = mean_MFI)) + 
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = function(x) calc_boxplot_stats(x),
    geom = "boxplot"
  ) +
  geom_jitter(aes(fill = phase, y = log_MFI), shape = 21, size = 2, alpha = 1, width = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_phase) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  geom_segment(data = df_sig, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y)) +
  geom_text(data = df_sig, aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = y, label = p), size = 3, vjust = 0) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1.8, 4)) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))


comb <- t(combn(levels(data$phase), 2)) %>% as_tibble()
df_sig <- lapply(1:nrow(comb), function(i) {
  guse <- comb[i,]
  t <- wilcox.test(x = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V1) %>% pull(mean_prop),
              y = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V2) %>% pull(mean_prop), paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE)
  c <- tibble(p = t$p.value, 
              xmin = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V1) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
              xmax = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V2) %>% pull(x) %>% unique(),
              x_min_group = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V1) %>% pull(phase) %>% unique(),
              x_max_group = data %>% dplyr::filter(phase == guse$V2) %>% pull(phase) %>% unique(),
              y = max(data$mean_prop)/100*(70 + i*3))
}) %>% Reduce("rbind", .)


ggplot(data, aes(x = phase, y = mean_prop)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_beeswarm(aes(fill = phase), shape = 21,  cex = 2, size = 2, alpha = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_phase) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(25, 50, 100), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  geom_segment(data = df_sig, aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y)) +
  geom_text(data = df_sig, aes(x = (xmin + xmax) / 2, y = y, label = p), size = 3, vjust = 0) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) 
  
```
